import numpy as np

# MECHANISM: Use a piecewise linear function with fewer breakpoints to better capture the trade-off between remaining capacity and priority.

def priority(item, bins):
    max_capacity = 150
    break1 = max_capacity / 4
    break2 = max_capacity / 2
    break3 = 3 * max_capacity / 4
    return np.piecewise(bins, 
                         [bins <= break1, bins <= break2, bins <= break3, bins > break3], 
                         [lambda x: x / break1, lambda x: (max_capacity - break1) / (break2 - break1) * (x - break1) + (x / break1), 
                          lambda x: (max_capacity - break2) / (break3 - break2) * (x - break2) + (max_capacity - break1) / (break2 - break1) * (x - break1) + (x / break1), 
                          lambda x: (max_capacity - break3) / (max_capacity - break3) * (x - break3) + (max_capacity - break2) / (break3 - break2) * (x - break2) + (max_capacity - break1) / (break2 - break1) * (x - break1) + (x / break1)])
